user.title: Connect Revolut X
user.description: Paste your Revolut X API key and the Ed25519 private key (PEM) you generated for it. See https://developer.revolut.com/docs/x-api for how to create these.

error.invalid_auth: The API key or private key was rejected by Revolut X.
error.invalid_private_key: Could not parse the private key as a PEM-encoded Ed25519 key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Revolut X API.

abort.already_configured: This Revolut X API key is already configured.

init.title: Revolut X MCP settings
init.description:
**Webhook URL** (works through Nabu Casa or any reverse proxy pointed at Home Assistant): `{webhook_url}`

**Direct URL** (same network only): `{direct_url}`

Paste one of these into your MCP client. Save this form to apply any changes below.

data_description.auth_mode: "none": the URL above is the credential. "legacy_oauth": clients must complete an OAuth sign-in instead.
data_description.direct_server_enabled: Also listen on a dedicated port on the local network, bypassing the Home Assistant webhook.
data_description.direct_server_port: TCP port for the direct server, only used when it's enabled above.
data_description.external_url: Overrides the auto-detected base URL used for OAuth discovery metadata. Leave blank to auto-detect from Home Assistant's own URL settings.
data_description.log_level: Verbosity of this integration's log messages.
